key_insight: ReactNexus discovers kinetically informed chemical reaction networks from reactant graphs without predefined products or reaction templates.
engineering_relevance: The framework can help engineers explore competing reaction pathways, identify lower-barrier routes, and interpret complex reaction mixtures.
method: Generate candidate transition states and full reaction trajectories from reactant graphs.
Use a machine-learned interatomic potential to verify connectivity and evaluate electronic barriers.
Expand reaction networks to reveal shared intermediates and competing branches.
evidence_signal: On an in-distribution benchmark of 10,000 generated candidates, 80.8% connected to the input reactant after DFT optimization and intrinsic reaction coordinate verification.
watch_item: The reported connectivity rate is in-distribution and does not establish network completeness or generalization to unfamiliar chemistry.
paper_title: Generative discovery of chemical reaction networks
